title.narrative: Building Pathways for Improving Sustainable Agricultural Production in Brazil

description.narrative: The proposed intervention aims at creating an institutional environment with a defined methodology that will enable the development, diffusion and exchange of knowledge, good practices, expertise and innovative agriculture tools between high-level technical officers and other stakeholders in order to support the adaptation of the successful models of sustainable agricultural production to interested parties. The knowledge generated and shared in this environment shall allow countries to improve their strategies of agricultural production as well as to increase their capabilities to tackle possible future food crises.
